text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Ryan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were totally amazing too, Mejiro 
McQueen--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!! You both worked so harddd!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though defeated by Mejiro Ryan, she still 
managed to achieve a splendid result on 
the grand stage of the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for having another serious match 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Did this... show off my big sister side 
even just a little bit, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"You have always been my dear sister whom 
I deeply respect. And what is more—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am the one who should be thanking you. 
If I hadn't raced against you again, I 
wouldn't have realized... how naive my own 
resolve truly was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm really grateful. Thank you, Ryan. 
Truly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to you, I feel like I finally 
understand... How I ought to carry myself 
as a member of the Mejiro family.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we managed to safely wrap up the 
Takarazuka Kinen, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
By racing against Ryan, my next objective 
has become clear to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Our next target is the Autumn Tenno Sho— 
in other words, winning both the Spring 
and Autumn editions.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is a feat that no one in the Mejiro 
family has ever accomplished before, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now that Grandmother has entrusted this to 
me, I want to show everyone a new path 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To Grandmother... and to everyone in the 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning both the Spring and Autumn Tenno 
Sho in the same year. Facing this new 
goal, a fiery resolve blazed in Mejiro 
McQueen's eyes.
